title: ever DAHLIA|Short Sleeves V-Neck Tea Length Wedding Guest Dress with Floral Applique
descriptionHtml:
Attend weddings with grace in our Short Sleeves V-Neck Tea Length Wedding Guest Dress with Floral Applique. The delicate floral applique adds a touch of romance to the tea-length silhouette, while the V-neck design exudes elegance. Perfect for garden weddings or intimate celebrations, this dress ensures a stylish and comfortable look, making you the epitome of charm at any wedding affair.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
